# App Store Compliance Instructions

> **Authority**: `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 15, § 23, § 25, and the detailed reference
> at `docs/reference/instructions/15-app-store-compliance.detail.md`.

## Default Context

This file is a compact routing stub. Load the detailed reference only when a
task touches App Store, Google Play, mobile compliance, safe-area behavior,
touch targets, store review readiness, mobile accessibility, or mobile
performance evidence.

## Required Rules

- Preserve safe-area handling and platform-aware layout.
- Maintain accessible touch targets and keyboard navigation.
- Validate mobile accessibility, launch performance, memory, offline behavior,
  and persistence before claiming store readiness.
- Follow `AGENTS.md` § 0.A for validation and self-correction.
